snippet.title: Gallery of Shadows - Lycans Returns Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to The Gallery of Shadows, a dark world where the creatures you've imagined in your nightmares and seen in fiction are now a reality.

Lycans Returns is the first game of the Gallery of Shadows and here you'll experience how a werewolf will reclaim the lands of his kind on a quest that will decide his fate.

Play our demo now available on Steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2895640/Gallery_of_Shadows__Lycans_Returns/
